summary: The ZH-29 was a semi-automatic rifle developed in Czechoslovakia in the late 1920s and used by the Chinese National Revolutionary Army. The note describes it as one of the first successful self-loading rifles to enter service. The note is brief and gives no further specifications, dates of adoption, or combat history.
one_line: The ZH-29 was a late-1920s Czechoslovak semi-automatic rifle used by China's National Revolutionary Army, counted among the first successful self-loading rifles in service.
key_facts: The ZH-29 was a semi-automatic rifle.
The ZH-29 was developed in Czechoslovakia during the late 1920s.
The ZH-29 was used by the Chinese National Revolutionary Army.
The ZH-29 is described as one of the first successful self-loading rifles in service.
